blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Far Eastern University-DN Steel swept the AEP Cabstars, 25-23, 25-17, 25-17, to jumpstart its 2026 Spikers’ Turf Invitational Conference on Saturday at FilOil EcoOil Centre in San Juan City. Dryx Saavedra led the collective effort of the Tamaraws with 14 points off 10 kills and four blocks, while setter Rhodson Du-ot dished out 14 excellent sets.
